# escalation_ladder.yaml 鈥?Conditional escalation ladder L0鈥揕4 (EscalationKit)
# Purpose : declarative ladder config consumed by trigger_eval.py,
#           verdict_aggregate.py, and the state machine script
# Input   : per-packet mechanical signals + trigger table actions
# Output  : routing decisions between ladder levels
# Lines   : ~120
#
# Power semantics (spec 搂3.5, 搂10 S5 鈥?HARDCODED in scripts, restated here):
#   - L1 and L2 can only BLOCK or ESCALATE. They can NEVER release to
#     publication. An L2 "pass" only exempts the packet from Sol per-packet
#     review and admits it to the merge queue; mechanical acceptance and the
#     human release gate still follow.
#   - High-risk class is deterministic direct-to-L3+L4; LLM judgment is only
#     input, never classifier.
#   - F2 cold start: escalation.passthrough_enabled=false closes the L0
#     all-green passthrough; every packet still reaches L3.
# ============================================================================

version: 1

power_semantics:
  l1_l2_can_release: false        # invariant 鈥?enforced in code, not just here
  high_risk_route: [L3, L4]       # deterministic, non-overridable
  llm_verdict_is_input_only: true # no LLM output may act as a classifier
  release_requires_human: true    # release merge is human-triggered only (S8)

levels:

  L0:
    name: mechanical_acceptance_trio
    bearer: "harness/diffvalidator.py + harness/acceptance_replay.sh"
    token_cost: zero
    mandatory: true               # every packet must pass, no exemptions
    checks:
      - diff_subset_assertion     # changes 鈯?packet.authorized_paths
      - acceptance_command_replay # oracle frozen before execution
      - min_test_count            # test count floor from packet.acceptance
    on_all_green_no_trigger:
      passthrough: config:escalation.passthrough_enabled   # F2: false -> L3
      passthrough_target: serial_merge_queue
    on_trigger_hit: L1

  L1:
    name: trigger_evaluator
    bearer: "harness/trigger_eval.py + config/triggers.yaml"
    token_cost: zero
    signals:
      - exit_code_sequence
      - retry_count
      - diff_lines_vs_budget
      - path_boundary_attempt
      - test_count_change_direction
      - high_risk_path_hit
      - observation_length_gt_3000
      - loop_fingerprint_ge_5
    actions: [pass, annotated_pass, send_l2, direct_l3, spawn_duty_officer]
    powers: [block, escalate]     # NEVER release

    name: cross_source_verifier

    powers: [block, escalate]     # "pass" = exempt from Sol per-packet review only
    note: cross-family verifier required 鈥?same-family has correlated blind spots (搂11)

    name: multi_candidate_on_demand

    token_cost: free_side
